notes: The Imam Baqir is named inside the chain after «عن», so he is a narrator; he is also the speaker of the saying ("أنه قال"), which makes him the last link.
«(رحمه الله)» and «(عليه السلام)» are blessings and are left out. The report number in the text (14) differs from the work's number (47); the text is read as written.
